about: A command line tool that updates every version string in a project's code and can commit and tag the release.

prs.title: Backslashes in version replacements are written as typed
prs.broken: A replacement with a backslash, like a LaTeX command or a Windows path, was mangled into control characters or stopped the version bump with an error.
prs.changed: The replacement text is now written exactly as configured; only the search pattern is treated as a pattern.
prs.matters: Projects that keep a version in LaTeX files or Windows paths can bump it without corrupting the file.
